description: Search upcoming travel-worthy events across every What's Up In city at once (Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Albuquerque, Almaty, Anchorage, Atlanta, Baltimore, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Buffalo, Cairo, Cancún, Cape Town, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Dallas-Fort Worth, DC, Denver, Detroit, Guangzhou, Havana, Honolulu, Houston, Inland Empire, Las Vegas, London, Mexico City, Miami, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Montreal, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Richmond, Rome, Salt Lake City, San Juan, Savannah, Seoul, Shanghai, St. Louis, Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver): where an artist, band, comedian or team is playing, which cities have a festival, conference or expo, big arena shows, races. Only events worth a trip are indexed (named performers, festivals, conferences/expos, arena shows, games, races), not every local listing; for everything in one city, use search_events with its city. Each result names its city and links to the original listing (`link`) and the event on that city's site (`on_site`). `searched` says which cities were included and how fresh each is.

cities.description: Only these cities (names or slugs): Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Albuquerque, Almaty, Anchorage, Atlanta, Baltimore, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Buffalo, Cairo, Cancún, Cape Town, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Dallas-Fort Worth, DC, Denver, Detroit, Guangzhou, Havana, Honolulu, Houston, Inland Empire, Las Vegas, London, Mexico City, Miami, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Montreal, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Richmond, Rome, Salt Lake City, San Juan, Savannah, Seoul, Shanghai, St. Louis, Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver. Default: all.

kinds.description: Only these kinds: act = named performers; festival = festival; major = major local festival; conference = conference / expo; big_show = arena or amphitheater show; game = sports game (any level); pro_game = professional sports game (MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, WNBA, NWSL); race = race.

near.description: "lat,lon": only events within radius_km of it, with distance_km. (search_events also takes place names.) Unmapped venues are left out (place.unplaced_events).

neighborhood.description: Only events in this neighborhood or town (whole words, e.g. 'Silver Lake', 'South End', 'Pasadena'). Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out; place.unplaced_events counts them.

query.description: An artist, band, comedian, team, festival or conference name, or words to match in titles/performers/venues, e.g. 'Khruangbin', 'Oktoberfest', 'AI summit'. Optional when `kinds`, `neighborhood` or `near` is given.

trip_only.description: Only events worth a special trip (multi-day festivals, festivals on a city's watchlist, arena/amphitheater shows, multi-day conferences, full-distance races). Default: true when there is no query, false when searching a name.

name: search_across_cities
title: Search events across all cities
